glosses: edifice (a building, especially an imposing one)
a large, multi-story building with rooms or floor belonging to different people or used for different purposes, such as an apartment block or skyscraper

examples.text: Quem tem uma chave deste prédio?
examples.en: Who has a key to this building?

examples.text: Olha aquele prédio. É um templo?
examples.en: Look at that building. Is it a temple?

examples.text: Roma tem um monte de prédios antigos.
examples.en: Rome has a lot of ancient buildings.
